text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dancing was her little sisters' dream. Up 
until the Arima Kinen, Ines Fujin had 
convinced herself of that all on her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That was why her little sisters... got 
angry with her. They told her not to 
decide their dreams for them. The pair's 
wish right now was to see their older 
sister shine."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her coworkers at her part-time job were 
also dreaming big through Ines Fujin's 
running. Her races had always struck a 
chord in people's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap, Mejiro Ryan... In an Arima 
Kinen filled with formidable rivals, Ines 
Fujin runs carrying the dreams of her 
family and everyone else!
